verdict.rationale: Cooley has a documented labor and employment practice serving more than 3,000 clients a year, which also handles noncompete and trade-secret matters. Its Cooley GO generators produce adjacent documents: an IP Assignment Agreement bundled into the founder Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement, and a mutual UK NDA form. However, the evidence never explicitly says the firm prepares employee hiring paperwork. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, or employee invention-assignment/confidentiality (PIIA) agreements, any employee-hiring template or generator, and independent corroboration.
